blockers.summary: Probes 1 and 2 are built, compiled and installable, but no Android device was attached, so the step's Definition of Done (measured numbers per device) cannot be met.
blockers.needed: Connect the Android phone by USB with USB debugging enabled and accept the RSA prompt, then run `npx expo run:android` from apps/mobile and press Run probe on the first two cards.
blockers.alsoNeeded: ANDROID_SDK_ROOT is malformed at the Windows user level (its value contains its own name). Builds work only when it is overridden per-invocation until that is corrected. See docs/RUNBOOK.md section 6.
blockers.iosNote: Probe measurement on iOS additionally needs hardware that does not exist (no iPhone, no Mac). The iOS source is written but has never been compiled. This is a known, pre-existing constraint recorded in D5/D12, not new.
blockers.note: Step 02 left in-progress deliberately on 2026-08-11: it cannot close without a mid-range Android and an iPhone, so the track moved on to 03 rather than idling. Everything buildable in 02 is built, committed and green.
